collegeFullAddress: Nande Village, Taluka Mulshi, Pune, Maharashtra 411033
collegeInfo: ISB&M Pune is a leading B-school in India offering innovative business education focused on employability, corporate interface, and global outlook. The campus is vibrant with academic, co-curricular, and social events. Alumni are found in leadership roles across major industries.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Top percentile in entrance test (CAT/XAT/CMAT/GMAT), strong academic performance, and strong closing round performance in selection process.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Shortlisted students are considered automatically during admissions based on merit.

scholarships.scholarshipName: Dr. Pramod Kumar Scholarship (Women in Management)
scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Awarded to women candidates with outstanding academic records and leadership potential.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Apply during admissions; shortlisting by committee based on profile and interactions.

events.eventFullDescription: Crescendo is the flagship fest of ISB&M Pune. It brings together students from B-schools across India to compete in management events, quizzes, business plan competitions, cultural performances, and sports tournaments. With celebrity appearances, DJ nights, and social causes, Crescendo is a showcase of the institute’s vibrancy.

Zest brings out the sporting spirit in ISB&M students. The inter- and intra-college tournaments include cricket, football, volleyball, table tennis, chess, and athletics. Zest is aimed at encouraging teamwork, leadership, and fitness.

ISB&M’s HR Share summit hosts HR leaders from top corporates who address trends in talent management, leadership, diversity, and digital HR. The event combines panel discussions, workshops, and networking sessions.
The E-Cell hosts ISB&M Pune's annual Startup Awards where students, alumni, and local entrepreneurs pitch their business ideas to investors and receive mentorship as well as prizes.

infrastructure.infraDescription:
The ISB&M Pune campus in Nande Village is spread over 15 acres with modern classrooms, amphitheatre, conference and seminar halls, high-speed Wi-Fi, a well-stocked digital library, and career guidance cell.

Academic Infrastructure:

  • Smart classrooms, media & analytics labs, digital resource center, language lab.

Hostels & Cafeteria:

  • Separate residential blocks for men and women, healthy meals, laundry, and convenience store.

Sports & Fitness:

  • Multi-sport complex with cricket grounds, basketball court, gymnasium, and swimming pool.

Other Amenities:

  • Medical center, transport facility, amphitheater, auditorium, meditation room, and collaborative learning spaces.
